## c2101 参考資料 図表1 障害者数（推計）の内部整合（L1）— 誤りなし
- 総数＝在宅者数＋施設入所者数（身体・知的）、総数＝外来患者＋入院患者（精神）：18行、丸めの幅（0.15万人）を超える差 0。
- 精神障害者数 603.0万人（外来 576.4・入院 26.6）は患者調査（令和5年）からの推計と注記されている。患者調査の作業ノートの表7（総患者数）との一致の確認は、精神障害者の定義（傷病の範囲）が白書の注で特定できないため、今回は行っていない。
dacd76587f359f3b8494e2400b78ad004529b025.en:
## c2101 Reference materials, Figure 1, Number of persons with disabilities (estimates): internal consistency (L1) — no errors
- Total = persons living at home + persons in residential facilities (physical, intellectual); total = outpatients + inpatients (mental): 18 rows; differences exceeding the rounding margin (0.15 ×10,000 persons): 0.
- The number of persons with mental disabilities, 603.0 ×10,000 persons (outpatients 576.4, inpatients 26.6), carries a note stating that it is an estimate from the Patient Survey (2023). A check of agreement with Table 7 (total number of patients) in the working notes for the Patient Survey has not been carried out this time, because the definition of persons with mental disabilities (the range of diseases and injuries) cannot be identified from the notes in the white paper.
